---
title: "Mask Grid Selat Sunda"
author: "Rafi Adabhi Sunarya"
date: "2026-09-13"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
cfg <- list(
  west = 103, east = 107, south = -8, north = -5,
  coastline_file = "",
  install_missing_packages = FALSE, write_outputs = TRUE,
  grid_step_deg = 0.25, selection_rule = "center",
  area_tolerance_m2 = 1, full_sea_tolerance = 1e-6
)

needed <- c("sf", "ggplot2", "jsonlite", "knitr")
missing <- needed[!vapply(needed, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing) && isTRUE(cfg$install_missing_packages)) {
  options(timeout = max(300, getOption("timeout", 60)))
  install.packages(missing, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
missing <- needed[!vapply(needed, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Paket belum tersedia: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       ". Jalankan di Console: install.packages(c(",
       paste(shQuote(missing), collapse = ", "),
       "), repos = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'). Lalu Knit kembali.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (utils::packageVersion("sf") < "1.0.0") {
  stop("Gunakan sf versi 1.0.0 atau lebih baru.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (utils::packageVersion("ggplot2") < "3.4.0") {
  stop("Perbarui ggplot2 ke versi 3.4.0 atau lebih baru di Console.", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                     error = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, dpi = 150)
options(digits = 15)

input_name <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
project_dir <- if (length(input_name) == 1L && !is.na(input_name) && nzchar(input_name)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(input_name, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else getwd()

stopifnot(is.numeric(cfg$west), is.numeric(cfg$east),
          is.numeric(cfg$south), is.numeric(cfg$north),
          cfg$west < cfg$east, cfg$south < cfg$north,
          is.numeric(cfg$grid_step_deg), cfg$grid_step_deg > 0,
          cfg$area_tolerance_m2 > 0,
          cfg$full_sea_tolerance > 0, cfg$full_sea_tolerance < 0.01)
bounds <- c(west = cfg$west, east = cfg$east,
            south = cfg$south, north = cfg$north)
if (any(!is.finite(bounds))) stop("Koordinat harus berupa angka terhingga.")
if (cfg$west < -180 || cfg$east > 180 ||
    cfg$south < -85 || cfg$north > 85) {
  stop("Domain di luar rentang yang didukung skrip lokal ini.")
}

step_deg <- cfg$grid_step_deg
global_nlon <- as.integer(round(360 / step_deg))
global_nlat <- as.integer(round(180 / step_deg))
if (abs(global_nlon * step_deg - 360) > 1e-10 ||
    abs(global_nlat * step_deg - 180) > 1e-10) {
  stop("grid_step_deg harus membagi 360 dan 180 tanpa sisa.")
}
if (!cfg$selection_rule %in% c("center", "majority", "any")) {
  stop("selection_rule harus berupa 'center', 'majority', atau 'any'.")
}
area_crs <- 6933L # proyeksi equal-area, luas dalam meter persegi
area_tol <- cfg$area_tolerance_m2
ratio_tol <- cfg$full_sea_tolerance

edge_units <- c((cfg$west + 180) / step_deg,
                (cfg$east + 180) / step_deg,
                (90 - cfg$north) / step_deg,
                (90 - cfg$south) / step_deg)
if (any(abs(edge_units - round(edge_units)) > 1e-7)) {
  stop("Batas harus berimpit dengan tepi grid analisis sebesar ", step_deg, " derajat.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
coast_is_embedded <- !nzchar(cfg$coastline_file)
same_domain <- max(abs(bounds - c(west=103, east=107, south=-8, north=-5))) < 1e-10
default_check <- same_domain && coast_is_embedded && abs(step_deg - 0.25) < 1e-10 &&
  identical(cfg$selection_rule, "center") &&
  isTRUE(all.equal(area_tol, 1)) && isTRUE(all.equal(ratio_tol, 1e-6))
```

# Parameter

```{r parameter-table}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Batas barat", "Batas timur", "Batas selatan", "Batas utara",
                "Resolusi grid", "Aturan grid laut"),
  Nilai = c(paste0(bounds["west"], "° BT"), paste0(bounds["east"], "° BT"),
            paste0(abs(bounds["south"]), "° LS"), paste0(abs(bounds["north"]), "° LS"),
            "0,25° × 0,25°", "Titik pusat berada di laut"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
), align = c("l", "l"))
```

```{r coastline-snapshot, include=FALSE}
coast_source_md5 <- "be3001f37196d2894e17aacd13ff2cc2"
coast_wkt_md5 <- "e344cff4b5a7150b82d5f897809f85ae"
snapshot_bounds <- c(west = 102, east = 108, south = -9, north = -4)
if (coast_is_embedded) {
  if (cfg$west < snapshot_bounds["west"] || cfg$east > snapshot_bounds["east"] ||
      cfg$south < snapshot_bounds["south"] || cfg$north > snapshot_bounds["north"]) {
    stop("Domain melampaui snapshot garis pantai. Isi coastline_file dengan poligon daratan yang mencakup domain baru.")
  }
  coast_raw <- memDecompress(jsonlite::base64_dec(coast_b64), type = "gzip")
  coast_wkt <- rawToChar(coast_raw)
  land_source <- sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_as_sfc(coast_wkt, crs = 4326))
  coast_label <- "Natural Earth Land v5.1.1, skala 1:10.000.000; snapshot 11 September 2026"
} else {
  if (!file.exists(cfg$coastline_file)) stop("Berkas coastline_file tidak ditemukan.")
  land_source <- sf::st_read(cfg$coastline_file, quiet = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(land_source))) stop("Berkas daratan harus memiliki CRS yang diketahui.")
  coast_label <- paste("Poligon daratan pengguna:", basename(cfg$coastline_file))
}
```

```{r ocean-mask}
domain_ll <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(c(
  xmin = cfg$west, ymin = cfg$south,
  xmax = cfg$east, ymax = cfg$north
), crs = sf::st_crs(4326)))
domain_area <- sf::st_transform(domain_ll, area_crs)

land_area <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_transform(land_source, area_crs))
land_types <- as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(land_area))
if (any(land_types == "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION")) {
  land_area <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_collection_extract(land_area, "POLYGON"))
}
if (!all(as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(land_area)) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))) {
  stop("coastline_file harus berupa poligon daratan, bukan garis pantai atau titik.")
}

land_parts <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_cast(sf::st_geometry(land_area), "POLYGON"))
land_filled <- sf::st_sfc(lapply(land_parts, function(p) {
  sf::st_polygon(list(p[[1]]))
}), crs = sf::st_crs(land_area))
land_filled <- land_filled[lengths(sf::st_intersects(land_filled, domain_area)) > 0]
if (!length(land_filled)) stop("Tidak ada daratan yang beririsan dengan domain; periksa sumber dan koordinat.")
land_crop <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(land_filled, domain_area))
land_crop <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(land_crop))
ocean_area <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_difference(domain_area, land_crop))
if (all(sf::st_is_empty(ocean_area))) stop("Mask laut kosong.")

stopifnot(all(sf::st_is_valid(ocean_area)))
land_overlap_m2 <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(
  suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(ocean_area, land_crop))
)))
if (land_overlap_m2 > area_tol) stop("Mask laut masih bertumpang-tindih dengan daratan.")

land_ll <- sf::st_transform(land_crop, 4326)
ocean_ll <- sf::st_transform(ocean_area, 4326)
```

```{r analysis-grid}
col_first <- as.integer(round((cfg$west + 180) / step_deg))
col_last <- as.integer(round((cfg$east + 180) / step_deg)) - 1L
row_first <- as.integer(round((90 - cfg$north) / step_deg))
row_last <- as.integer(round((90 - cfg$south) / step_deg)) - 1L
stopifnot(col_first >= 0, col_last < global_nlon,
          row_first >= 0, row_last < global_nlat)

grid_table <- expand.grid(
  col_nc0 = seq.int(col_first, col_last),
  row_nc0 = seq.int(row_first, row_last),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (nrow(grid_table) > 100000) stop("Lebih dari 100.000 sel. Perkecil domain untuk percobaan awal.")
grid_table$cell_no <- seq_len(nrow(grid_table))
grid_table$grid_id <- sprintf("G025_R%03d_C%04d", grid_table$row_nc0, grid_table$col_nc0)
grid_table$lon <- -180 + (grid_table$col_nc0 + 0.5) * step_deg
grid_table$lat <- 90 - (grid_table$row_nc0 + 0.5) * step_deg
grid_table$row_R1 <- grid_table$row_nc0 + 1L
grid_table$col_R1 <- grid_table$col_nc0 + 1L
grid_table$west <- -180 + grid_table$col_nc0 * step_deg
grid_table$east <- -180 + (grid_table$col_nc0 + 1) * step_deg
grid_table$south <- 90 - (grid_table$row_nc0 + 1) * step_deg
grid_table$north <- 90 - grid_table$row_nc0 * step_deg
grid_table$row_bbox_R1 <- grid_table$row_nc0 - row_first + 1L
grid_table$col_bbox_R1 <- grid_table$col_nc0 - col_first + 1L
stopifnot(
  all(abs(grid_table$lon - (grid_table$west + grid_table$east)/2) < 1e-10),
  all(abs(grid_table$lat - (grid_table$south + grid_table$north)/2) < 1e-10),
  all(abs(grid_table$east - grid_table$west - step_deg) < 1e-10),
  all(abs(grid_table$north - grid_table$south - step_deg) < 1e-10)
)

if (same_domain) {
  stopifnot(
    abs(min(grid_table$lon) - 103.125) < 1e-9,
    abs(max(grid_table$lon) - 106.875) < 1e-9,
    abs(max(grid_table$lat) - (-5.125)) < 1e-9,
    abs(min(grid_table$lat) - (-7.875)) < 1e-9
  )
}
cell_geometry <- sf::st_sfc(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid_table)), function(k) {
  x0 <- grid_table$west[k]
  x1 <- grid_table$east[k]
  y0 <- grid_table$south[k]
  y1 <- grid_table$north[k]
  sf::st_polygon(list(matrix(c(x0,y0, x1,y0, x1,y1, x0,y1, x0,y0), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)))
}), crs = 4326)
grid_analysis <- sf::st_sf(grid_table, geometry = cell_geometry)
grid_area <- sf::st_transform(grid_analysis, area_crs)
grid_area$cell_area_km2 <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(grid_area)) / 1e6
```

```{r grid-ocean-intersection}
grid_water_all <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(grid_area, ocean_area))
water_m2 <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(grid_water_all))
grid_water_all <- grid_water_all[is.finite(water_m2) & water_m2 > area_tol, ]
if (!nrow(grid_water_all)) stop("Tidak ada grid laut yang lolos toleransi geometri.")
if (anyDuplicated(grid_water_all$grid_id)) {
  stop("ID terduplikasi setelah overlay. Gabungkan fragmen per grid_id sebelum menghitung sel.")
}

grid_area$sea_area_km2 <- 0
water_index <- match(grid_water_all$grid_id, grid_area$grid_id)
grid_area$sea_area_km2[water_index] <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(grid_water_all)) / 1e6
grid_area$sea_fraction <- pmin(1, pmax(0, grid_area$sea_area_km2 / grid_area$cell_area_km2))
grid_area$status <- ifelse(grid_area$sea_area_km2 * 1e6 <= area_tol, "Daratan",
                          ifelse(grid_area$sea_fraction >= 1 - ratio_tol,
                                 "Laut penuh", "Pesisir campuran"))

analysis_centers <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_table, coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                             crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
center_area <- sf::st_transform(analysis_centers, area_crs)
grid_area$center_at_sea <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(center_area, ocean_area)) > 0

grid_area$selected <- switch(
  cfg$selection_rule,
  center = grid_area$center_at_sea,
  majority = grid_area$sea_fraction >= 0.5,
  any = grid_area$sea_area_km2 * 1e6 > area_tol
)
grid_area$selection_rule <- cfg$selection_rule

grid_water_all$cell_area_km2 <- grid_area$cell_area_km2[water_index]
grid_water_all$sea_area_km2 <- grid_area$sea_area_km2[water_index]
grid_water_all$sea_fraction <- grid_area$sea_fraction[water_index]
grid_water_all$status <- grid_area$status[water_index]
grid_water_all$center_at_sea <- grid_area$center_at_sea[water_index]
grid_water_all$selected <- grid_area$selected[water_index]
grid_water_all$selection_rule <- cfg$selection_rule

selected_ids <- grid_area$grid_id[grid_area$selected]
grid_water <- grid_water_all[grid_water_all$grid_id %in% selected_ids, ]
if (!nrow(grid_water)) stop("Tidak ada grid model yang lolos aturan pemilihan.")
grid_water_ll <- sf::st_transform(grid_water, 4326)
grid_metadata <- sf::st_drop_geometry(grid_area)
marine_metadata <- grid_metadata[grid_metadata$selected, ]

ocean_km2 <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(ocean_area))) / 1e6
reconstructed_km2 <- sum(grid_water_all$sea_area_km2)
area_difference_m2 <- abs(ocean_km2 - reconstructed_km2) * 1e6
if (area_difference_m2 > max(1, nrow(grid_area) * area_tol)) {
  stop("Jumlah luas irisan sel tidak cocok dengan luas mask laut. Periksa geometri.")
}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(marine_metadata$grid_id),
          all(marine_metadata$selected),
          all(marine_metadata$sea_fraction > 0),
          all(marine_metadata$sea_fraction <= 1))
```

# Ringkasan

```{r grid-counts}
n_bbox <- nrow(grid_area)
n_intersect <- sum(grid_metadata$status != "Daratan")
n_marine <- nrow(marine_metadata)
n_full <- sum(marine_metadata$status == "Laut penuh")
n_coastal <- sum(marine_metadata$status == "Pesisir campuran")
n_land <- sum(grid_metadata$status == "Daratan")
n_not_selected <- n_bbox - n_marine
stopifnot(n_bbox == n_marine + n_not_selected,
          n_marine == n_full + n_coastal,
          n_intersect >= n_marine)

summary_grid <- data.frame(
  Kelompok = c("Seluruh grid 0,25°", "Grid terpilih", "Laut penuh",
               "Pesisir", "Dikeluarkan"),
  Jumlah = c(n_bbox, n_marine, n_full, n_coastal, n_not_selected)
)
knitr::kable(summary_grid, format.args = list(big.mark = "."), align = c("l", "r"))

```

```{r independent-check, results='hide'}
check_note <- "Pembanding dilewati karena domain, garis pantai, atau toleransi diubah."
if (default_check) {
  expected <- c(n_bbox=192L, n_intersect=172L, n_marine=148L,
                n_full=121L, n_coastal=27L, n_land=20L)
  observed <- c(n_bbox=n_bbox, n_intersect=n_intersect, n_marine=n_marine,
                n_full=n_full, n_coastal=n_coastal, n_land=n_land)
  check_table <- data.frame(
    Ukuran = names(expected),
    Pembanding_independen = unname(expected),
    Hasil_R = unname(observed),
    Cocok = unname(expected == observed)
  )
  print(knitr::kable(check_table))
  check_note <- if (all(check_table$Cocok)) {
    "Dimensi dan pemilihan grid 0,25 derajat cocok dengan pemeriksaan geometris."
  } else {
    "Hasil R berbeda dari pembanding. Jangan gunakan angka final sebelum memeriksa sumber, versi paket, dan overlay."
  }
  if (!all(check_table$Cocok)) warning(check_note, call. = FALSE)
}
cat("\n\n", check_note, "\n\n", sep="")
```

```{r map-functions}
map_view <- function(xlim = c(cfg$west, cfg$east),
                     ylim = c(cfg$south, cfg$north)) {
  ggplot2::coord_sf(crs=sf::st_crs(4326), default_crs=sf::st_crs(4326),
                    xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim, expand=FALSE, default=FALSE)
}
base_map <- function() {
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = sf::st_sf(geometry=domain_ll), fill="white", color=NA) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position="bottom") +
    ggplot2::labs(x="Bujur", y="Lintang")
}
map_mask <- base_map() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data=sf::st_sf(geometry=ocean_ll), fill="lightblue", color=NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data=sf::st_sf(geometry=land_ll), fill="grey80", color="grey50", linewidth=0.25) +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Mask laut") +
  map_view()
map_grid <- base_map() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data=grid_water_ll, ggplot2::aes(fill=status), color="grey30", linewidth=0.2) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data=sf::st_sf(geometry=land_ll), fill="grey80", color="grey50", linewidth=0.25) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values=c("Laut penuh"="skyblue", "Pesisir campuran"="khaki"), name=NULL) +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Grid laut terpilih") +
  map_view()
```

```{r coordinate-tables}
coordinate_columns <- c("grid_id", "cell_no", "lon", "lat",
                        "west", "east", "south", "north",
                        "row_nc0", "col_nc0", "row_R1", "col_R1",
                        "row_bbox_R1", "col_bbox_R1",
                        "status", "sea_fraction", "center_at_sea",
                        "selected", "selection_rule")
marine_coordinates <- marine_metadata[, coordinate_columns]
marine_coordinates$crs_epsg <- 4326L

marine_centers <- sf::st_as_sf(marine_coordinates, coords=c("lon","lat"),
                              crs=4326, remove=FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(marine_coordinates) == n_marine,
          !anyNA(marine_coordinates[, c("lon","lat","west","east","south","north")]),
          !anyDuplicated(marine_coordinates$grid_id))
```

```{r export-results, results='hide'}
if (isTRUE(cfg$write_outputs)) {
  output_csv <- file.path(project_dir, "output_grid_target.csv")
  utils::write.csv(marine_coordinates, output_csv,
                   row.names=FALSE, fileEncoding="UTF-8")
  csv_check <- utils::read.csv(output_csv,
                               stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  stopifnot(identical(csv_check$grid_id, marine_coordinates$grid_id),
            nrow(csv_check) == n_marine,
            max(abs(csv_check$lon - marine_coordinates$lon)) < 1e-10,
            max(abs(csv_check$lat - marine_coordinates$lat)) < 1e-10)
}
```
